task1.title: Road access to a city hospital in 2007 and 2010
task1.prompt: The two maps below show road access to a city hospital in 2007 and in 2010.

chartDesc.title: City Hospital 2007 / City Hospital 2010

features: Hospital Rd (connecting City Road to Ring Road)
6 bus stops along Hospital Rd (3 on each side)
Car park: staff and public (located east of Hospital Rd)
Roundabout at the junction of City Road and Hospital Rd
Roundabout at the junction of Hospital Rd and Ring Road
Bus station (located west of Hospital Rd, connected to both roundabouts)
Staff car park (located east of Hospital Rd)
Public car park (located east of Ring Road)

changes: Two roundabouts were added at both ends of Hospital Rd (at the City Road junction and the Ring Road junction).
The six bus stops along Hospital Rd were removed.
A new Bus station was built to the west of Hospital Rd, accessed via both roundabouts.
The combined 'Car park: staff and public' was replaced by a dedicated 'Staff car park' in the same location.
A new 'Public car park' was constructed to the east of the Ring Road.
chartDesc.overview: Between 2007 and 2010, road access to City Hospital was improved through the addition of two roundabouts, a dedicated bus station replacing roadside bus stops, and the separation of staff and public car parking facilities.
unchanged: Ring Road location surrounding the hospital
keyFeatures: Addition of two roundabouts on Hospital Rd at its junctions with City Road and Ring Road
Replacement of six roadside bus stops on Hospital Rd with a new bus station to the west
Separation of the combined staff and public car park into a dedicated staff car park and a new public car park to the east of Ring Road

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Living in a country where you have to speak a foreign language
task2.prompt:
Living in a country where you have to speak a foreign language can cause serious social problems, as well as practical problems.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
